description: This file defines the LookupTableEntry class, which models an entry in a lookup table with numeric value ranges and an associated score. It includes constructors, getters, and setters for its fields.

classes.name: LookupTableEntry
classes.description: A data class representing a lookup table entry with a range defined by valueFrom and valueTo, and an associated score.

methods.name: LookupTableEntry
methods.description: Default constructor for the LookupTableEntry class.

methods.name: LookupTableEntry
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing valueFrom, valueTo, and score fields.

methods.name: getValueFrom
methods.description: Returns the starting value of the lookup range.

methods.name: setValueFrom
methods.description: Sets the starting value of the lookup range.

methods.name: getValueTo
methods.description: Returns the ending value of the lookup range.

methods.name: setValueTo
methods.description: Sets the ending value of the lookup range.

methods.name: getScore
methods.description: Returns the score associated with this lookup entry.

methods.name: setScore
methods.description: Sets the score for this lookup entry.
